network.description: Bring up the board's wired network (DHCP) before PHP starts. On Wi-Fi boards the script connects with ext-wifi. Runtimes that need a network turn it on by themselves.

on-error.description: An uncaught exception in loop() or in an event handler: stop the program (like the php CLI), or print it as a warning and go on. Fatal errors always stop. In web-server an error ends only that request.

restart-delay.description: Seconds the board waits before restarting once the program has ended.

firmware-reserve.description: PSRAM in KB left to the rest of the firmware (network, HTTP server, native extensions); PHP gets the rest as memory_limit.

optimization.description: Compiler optimization of the whole firmware: size (-Os, the smallest app), performance (-O2, faster PHP, bigger app) or debug (-Og, for debugging with gdb).

power-save.description: Automatic light sleep: the board sleeps by itself while every task waits (between events, between two loop() runs). power_hold() keeps it awake; not with I2cBus::CORE1; the USB-JTAG console keeps it awake while connected.

request-timeout.description: Time limit in seconds for handling one HTTP request (web-server runtime, or ext-web requests in event-driven): PHP gets max_execution_time = this value and the server answers 503 after it plus 5 s. 0 = no limit.
